expected_after_equal_intravascular_repla: patient-directed ECMO flow returns approximately to baseline
drainage pressure returns approximately to baseline

expected: drainage pressure becomes substantially more negative
patient-directed flow does not meaningfully improve while drainage-limited
MAP does not recover to the euvolemic baseline solely from RPM escalation

allowed_exceptions: different RPM/preload combinations may not chatter
extreme vasoplegia or other unsupported concurrent pathology may alter MAP response
bridge/shunt configuration changes may alter gross circuit flow without increasing patient drainage capacity
displayed values may lag true state according to the dynamic display model
notes: The 15% blood-volume-loss stimulus is a stable regression stimulus, not a validated neonatal treatment threshold.
This contract asserts direction and bedside coherence rather than exact patient prediction.
RPM is an input; flow remains an outcome.
